rows.label: tlk45300143_02_msg0001
rows.name:
In the mercenaries, one wrong move
and it could be the end for you.

rows.label: tlk45300143_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Even the Boss of the Hræsvelgr
Merc Group doesn't get any
special treatment there...

rows.label: tlk45300143_02_msg0003
rows.name:
A skilled, bold, charismatic man...
And yet death comes for everyone
just the same.

rows.label: tlk45300143_02_msg0004
rows.name:
There's no time to grieve. Especially
not for the one who succeeds him.

rows.label: tlk45300143_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Don't stop. Just keep running forward.
That's all you can do.
